pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū Kokanade pāsāde sāmisena hatthena pāniyathālakaṃ paṭigaṇhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā sāmisena hatthena pāniyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessanti seyyathāpi gihikāmabhogino 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū sāmisena hatthena pāniyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū sāmisena hatthena pāniyathālakaṃ paṭigaṇhantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.11: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā sāmisena hatthena pāniyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.12: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.13: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.14.1: na sāmisena hatthena pāniyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.16: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca sāmisena hatthena pāniyathālakaṃ paṭigaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
